BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Public Safety.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Requiring a signed search warrant prior to deploying a radar device.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring a signed search warrant prior to deploying a radar device; and adding a new section to chapter 10.79 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 10.79 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: A magistrate must affix his or her signature to a search warrant before any law enforcement agency deploys a radar device that is used to detect human presence inside a residence.
